definitions.explanation: A compound referring to both males and females collectively.

examples.japanese: {男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう}は{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{男女|だんじょ}{合|あ}わせて{百|ひゃく}{人|にん}が{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: A total of one hundred people, both men and women, participated.

examples.japanese: {男女|だんじょ}{別|べつ}のトイレがある。
examples.english: There are separate toilets for men and women.

notes:
COMPOUND: {男|だん} (male) + {女|じょ} (female)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {男女|だんじょ}{平等|びょうどう} (gender equality)
- {男女|だんじょ}{差別|さべつ} (gender discrimination)
- {男女|だんじょ}{共同|きょうどう}{参画|さんかく} (gender equality participation)
- {男女|だんじょ}{別|べつ} (separated by gender)
- {男女|だんじょ}{混合|こんごう} (mixed gender, co-ed)

NOTE: When referring to 'male and female' in contexts like animals, {雄|おす} (male) and {雌|めす} (female) are used instead.
